page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose instance featuring 2 vCPUs backed by 1 physical core of an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz with two hyperthreads. The instance includes 8.0 GB of RAM, yielding a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It operates on x86_64 architecture with KVM virtualization and supports extended instruction sets including AVX-512, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. No dedicated GPUs or local NVMe storage are attached, and network baseline throughput is rated at 3 Gbps.

Benchmark measurements reveal high per-core single-threaded efficiency, with Geekbench single-core reaching 2006.0 and stress-ng single-core placing in the top 25% of evaluated systems. However, total aggregate computing power is limited by the single physical core layout, resulting in lower scores in multi-threaded evaluations such as multi-core stress-ng and software compilation. Uncached memory throughput performs at an average baseline, posting 47.71 GB/sec for large-block reads and 27.73 GB/sec for writes, while static web serving throughput and database operations score in lower benchmark brackets.

The ecs.g8ae.large instance offers high single-core CPU throughput and modern instruction acceleration in a lightweight hardware footprint. While constrained by its low overall thread density and lack of local storage, the instance avoids resource bloat, providing efficiency for applications reliant on single-thread responsiveness rather than parallel multi-core scaling. Recommended workload fits include low-traffic web serving, lightweight microservices, utility tasks, single-threaded batch processing, and CI/CD agent nodes requiring modern x86 CPU features.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ae.large is a general-purpose cloud instance equipped with 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core of an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at 3.4 GHz. It provides 8.0 GB of memory, a 3 Gbps baseline network interface, and KVM virtualization without local storage or dedicated GPUs. Featuring support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, SHA_NI, and AES, the instance excels in single-core responsiveness, achieving strong top-tier single-threaded CPU benchmark results. Conversely, its aggregate multi-core throughput and database operation metrics remain limited due to the 2 vCPU resource ceiling. Uncached memory bandwidth holds at moderate levels, reaching 47.71 GB/sec for reads. The configuration presents a resource-dense setup suitable for light microservices, small API endpoints, background scripts, and single-threaded processing tasks.
